summary: The minimal covering witness shows the accepted index inflated, but without a control it could be read as any StopSign-carrying sync raising the index. This experiment runs the same follower and the same StopSign-carrying payload with sync_idx 2, so the prefix stops just before the marker instead of covering it. A ready event records node 5 at accepted 3 with the marker present before the sync, and after_sync records accepted, decided, is_reconfigured and the entry kinds at indices 2 and 3. The declared comparison requires accepted to stay 3 for any admitted run, so a passing comparison would isolate the covering prefix as the trigger and confirm that the inflation is specific to a sync whose prefix already includes the StopSign. The previously observed covering case, with sync_idx 3, remains a violated comparison in its own receipt. Both tests are selected independently and no other records change. Together they would give the investigation a matched pair: one sync that stays consistent and one that inflates the accepted index by exactly one and relocates the marker.
